#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int n, m;
int dp[41][41][5]; // dp[i][j][k] = max free cells up to cell (i,j) with spider at (i,j) moving in direction k

int dx[] = {0, 0, 0, -1, 1}; // stay, left, right, up, down
int dy[] = {0, -1, 1, 0, 0};

int main() {
    cin >> n >> m;
    if (n == 1 && m == 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    // Initialize DP table
    memset(dp, -1, sizeof(dp));
    
    // Base case: first cell (0,0)
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        int nx = 0 + dx[k];
        int ny = 0 + dy[k];
        if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < m) {
            dp[0][0][k] = 0; // spider moves to (nx, ny), so cell (0,0) becomes free
        }
    }
    
    // Fill DP table
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
                if (dp[i][j][k] == -1) continue;
                
                // Try all possible moves for the next spider
                int ni = (j + 1 < m) ? i : i + 1;
                int nj = (j + 1 < m) ? j + 1 : 0;
                
                if (ni >= n) continue;
                
                for (int nk = 0; nk < 5; nk++) {
                    int nni = ni + dx[nk];
                    int nnj = nj + dy[nk];
                    if (nni >= 0 && nni < n && nnj >= 0 && nnj < m) {
                        // Check if current spider's move and next spider's move result in different cells
                        int ci = i + dx[k];
                        int cj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ci != nni || cj != nnj) {
                            dp[ni][nj][nk] = max(dp[ni][nj][nk], dp[i][j][k] + 1);
                        } else {
                            dp[ni][nj][nk] = max(dp[ni][nj][nk], dp[i][j][k]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Find the maximum free cells
    int ans = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        ans = max(ans, dp[n-1][m-1][k]);
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
